nodes.name: api_tenant
nodes.description: one row per Autoscal tenant, mirroring auth-service. Root of every tenant-owned row in the service.

nodes.name: api_role
nodes.description: tenant roles mirrored from auth-service; used to grant documents to roles.

nodes.name: api_user
nodes.description: tenant members mirrored from auth-service; the request.user of every session and Slack request.

nodes.name: api_assistant
nodes.description: named assistants per tenant (seeded: HR, IT, Finance per api/helpers/seed_data.py); documents can be attached to assistants for list filtering.

nodes.name: api_llmprovider
nodes.description: one configured LLM provider account per row, with its encrypted API key.
modules: Tool loop, flows and HRMS response audit

nodes.name: api_llmchatmodel
nodes.description: chat model catalogue per provider, seeded from api/helpers/llm_models_seeder.py:9-60.
modules: Tool loop, flows and HRMS response audit

nodes.name: api_llmembeddingmodel
nodes.description: embedding model catalogue per provider, with its vector dimension.

nodes.name: api_tenantllmsetting
nodes.description: the tenant's selected provider, chat model and embedding model. At most one enabled row per tenant; the previous selection is kept disabled.
modules: Tool loop, flows and HRMS response audit

nodes.name: api_resource
nodes.description: one uploaded policy document: file metadata, processing state, access grants, version link.

nodes.name: api_resource_roles
nodes.description: grants a document to roles.

nodes.name: api_resource_specific_users
nodes.description: grants a document to individual members.

nodes.name: api_resource_assistants
nodes.description: attaches a document to assistants; used to filter the document list.

nodes.name: api_resourcepage
nodes.description: extracted text of one page (chunk) of a document; source text for embeddings and citations.

nodes.name: api_documentembedding
nodes.description: one embedding vector per page per embedding model; searched by cosine distance.

nodes.name: api_suggestion
nodes.description: LLM-generated sample questions per document, shown as chat suggestions.

nodes.description: one web conversation owned by a member.

nodes.description: rolling LLM summary of a chat, fed to later tool-calling turns.

nodes.description: raw HRMS API responses captured per chat turn, for debugging and audit.
